fact: The Ministry of Health's HMIS Eswatini unit says a workshop in Piggs Peak tested and validated the integration of CMIS, the national EMR, with eLMIS, so that dispensing by a clinician in CMIS updates eLMIS stock automatically; it runs for ART medicines only and is ready for facility-level pilot ahead of national scale-up (workshop undated, published date used).

The Data.FI project says CMIS is used in 73% of the country's health facilities, with 233 live sites; the share is of all health facilities, not of primary clinics alone, and no denominator is given (no date stated, published date used).

Data.FI says clinicians open a client's full record in CMIS on a unique ID number and are led through guided modules at their point of service, and that the record is available to clinicians at another clinic if the patient moves district (no date stated, published date used).

Data.FI describes CMIS in use in the outpatient department of Piggs Peak Government Hospital and at local health clinics, within 233 live sites; it names no other tier (no date stated, published date used).
